answer: The materiality threshold for raising a P1 balance mismatch is USD 1,000,000 or more for one product and business unit, or if it changes a regulatory ratio that is reported that day [1].

sources.text:
DPM-003: Data Issue Priority and Materiality (synthetic analogue) > Materiality
A balance mismatch is **material** if it is USD 1,000,000 equivalent or more for one product and business unit, or if it changes a regulatory ratio that is reported that day.

DPM-003: Data Issue Priority and Materiality (synthetic analogue) > Priority matrix
| Priority | When | First analysis due | Fix or explanation due |
|---|---|---|---|
| P1 – Critical | Material mismatch (USD 1,000,000 or more), or any mismatch that blocks a same-day regulatory submission such as the liquidity (LCR) report | 1 hour | Before the submission deadline |
| P2 – High | USD 100,000 to 1,000,000, or blocks a report due within 3 business days | 4 hours | 1 business day |
| P3 – Normal | Below USD 100,000, or tagging errors with no report due within 3 business days | 1 business day | 3 business days |
| P4 – Low | Questions, clarifications, documentation requests | 2 business days | 5 business days |

DPM-003: Data Issue Priority and Materiality (synthetic analogue) > Escalation
- P1 tickets are escalated to the Data Production lead immediately and updated every 30 minutes until resolved.
- If a P1 cannot be fixed before the submission deadline, the regulatory-reporting team is informed so the submission can carry an explanation.

DPM-001: Feed Arrival and Reconciliation (synthetic analogue) > First checks for any balance mismatch
1. Check the feed-arrival dashboard: did the feed arrive, and on time?
2. Compare the record count and the control total in the control file with what was loaded. A difference means records were rejected or dropped during load.
3. Check the load-rejection log for the date and product.
4. Check whether a reference-data change was made in the last 5 business days (see DPM-002).
5. Only after these checks, compare against the source ledger at account level.
